text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shoot... Lights out on the track is 
coming up soon. I didn't notice the time 
at all—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...How strange. Even though I ran until 
this late, my body feels lighter than 
usual...?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Did Trainer make a new training regimen 
for me?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(So that I can reduce the strain on my 
body even more...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's why, huh. ...You really 
are amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: With this— I can push myself even harder.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're not thinking about running just a 
little more, are you~?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're out of time for today! You gotta 
wrap it up~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Don't worry, we'll finish up 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You look pretty happy. Did something 
good happen?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...I will turn Trainer's feelings into 
victory. —Without fail.)
